findings.passage: When a person votes at a polling place in Indiana, they must show photo ID. Do you support or oppose requiring people to include an ID number (such as their driver's license number) when they submit an application to vote by mail?
findings.note: Question Freeman put to his Senate District 32 constituents in his 2022 mailed and online survey. The results sheet, issued in his name, reports 80% support and 20% oppose for an ID number on mail-in ballot applications. The sheet states no position of his own. Date is the survey year; the PDF is undated.
